title: Seven-Day Truth
next_chapter_hook: The ancient jade pendant fell into his palm, a desolate yet familiar fluctuation instantly piercing his soul—Chen Ji abruptly raised his head, pupils contracting violently: this was his father's aura! How could he have something of his father's?

text.content: Midnight, Tianqing Sect Servants' Quarters. Chen Ji sat alone by the window, moonlight casting his gaunt profile pale as paper. The cold touch of the Tianji Record Fragment in his Mental Sea still lingered, the lingering resonance of "your sister" coiling around his heart like a venomous snake. Seven days... exactly seven days, he had been ceaselessly contemplating what the Heavenly Fate Key taken by the Holy Sect truly meant. Yet tonight, there was something more urgent—his appointed time with Ye Qing, the Demonic Path Saint, had arrived.

An exotic fragrance suddenly drifted through the window, orchid-like and musky, yet carrying a terrifyingly bizarre quality. Chen Ji's gaze sharpened, but he didn't rise—with his cultivation level, he couldn't detect any fluctuation of energy, which could only mean the visitor's strength far surpassed his own. The door opened soundlessly, and beneath the moonlight, a graceful figure stood poised. A blue纱 veil covered her face, revealing only a pair of deep eyes like an abyss, their depths flickering with what seemed like stars. "Seven-day appointment, Young Master Chen, your memory is quite clear." Ye Qing's voice was cold and clear as a spring. "Every step I take into Tianqing Sect, I must endure three counterattacks from the protective mountain formation. Worth it?" Chen Ji slowly rose, a hint of indifference curling at his lips. "The Saint need not personally take such risks." "Some words require face-to-face delivery to show sincerity." Ye Qing stepped into the room, her elegant hand gently raised as a幽紫结界 enveloped them both. "Moreover... I'm quite curious what the废物杂役 of Tianqing Sect has been pondering these seven days."

dialogue.content: The content of the seven-day agreement, you may now tell me.

text.content: Ye Qing gazed at him for a moment, then suddenly laughed lightly—that laughter was clear as silver bells, yet carried an indescribable and inexplicable meaning. "Young Master Chen truly has composure. If it were someone else, knowing they only have seven hundred chapters of life remaining, they would have gone mad long ago." Chen Ji's eyes darkened slightly. So she indeed knew the warning from the Tianji Record. "The Saint's information network is quite efficient." His voice remained cold as usual. "But I'd like to know, this seven-day agreement... what exactly is being agreed upon?" Ye Qing收起 her smile and took a yellowed silk scroll from her sleeve, gently placing it on the table. The calligraphy on the scroll was simple and bold, yet carried a sinister crimson color—that was a blood contract.

dialogue.content: This is the original of my Holy Sect's "Seven-Day Blood Pact." The content is simple: I help you survive the conflict among the three major sects, and you grant me a promise—in the future, whatever request I make, you cannot refuse.

text.content: Ye Qing's voice was calm to the point of coldness. "Don't be hasty to refuse. This promise seems unequal, but in truth... I will only ask once, and it will never violate heavenly ethics." Chen Ji lowered his head to look at the blood scroll, his brow furrowed tightly. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his Mental Sea: "Be careful. Once the blood pact is signed, it becomes a soul brand—those who break it will be struck by lightning from heaven. However... she's telling the truth. This contract does indeed have only one clause." "The Saint is perhaps overly confident." Chen Ji raised his eyes, cold light flickering in his depths. "How can you be certain I will agree?" Ye Qing's lips curved slightly. "Because fifteen years ago, someone owed me a life. And you... are his son." Chen Ji's pupils contracted violently.

Ye Qing slowly removed her veil, revealing a cold and beautiful visage. She watched Chen Ji's shocked expression, a complex emotion flashing in her eyes. "Fifteen years ago, in the depths of the Demon Territory, I saved a young cultivator who had wandered into the forbidden grounds. He was severely wounded, on the brink of death. I used my own essence blood to sustain him for three days until he was found and brought back." Her voice softened slightly. "He told me his name was Chen Xuan. He had a son named Chen Ji." Chen Ji's entire body stiffened. Father never mentioned this! "I don't believe it." His voice was hoarse. "Father never..." "Of course he wouldn't mention it." Ye Qing interrupted him. "Because that memory was erased by me. He only remembers surviving a great disaster, but doesn't remember who his savior was. That was my demand—I didn't want this karmic connection to entangle his family." She paused, her gaze deep and dark. "Unfortunately... fate is mischievous. His son actually became the inheritor of the Tianji Record. And I... have been controlled by the Holy Sect, finding it hard to escape."

choice.prompt: Ye Qing revealed her connection to his father. How should Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: Although shocked, with the truth of his father's survival laid out before him, Chen Ji chose to believe Ye Qing.
choices.visible_reward: Gaining Ye Qing's trust, unlocking possibilities for cooperation
choices.risk_hint: Potentially falling into the Demonic Path's scheme

choices.description: Chen Ji is inherently suspicious by nature and would not believe the Demonic Path Saint merely based on one-sided testimony.

dialogue.content: Words are empty. Since you're my father's lifesaver, do you have proof?
I knew you would ask this.

text.content: Ye Qing sighed lightly, taking an ancient jade pendant from her bosom. The pendant was pure white, with an unusual rune carved in the center—that was the Chen family's ancestral token! "Back then he left this jade pendant as a token, saying if one day his descendants came seeking, they could recognize each other by it." Ye Qing handed the jade pendant to Chen Ji. "Fifteen years... I've finally been able to return it to its rightful owner." The moment Chen Ji took the jade pendant, a familiar aura rushed into his soul. This was his father's aura! There was no mistake! Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his Mental Sea: "It's real. Every word she spoke is true. Chen Xuan was indeed selected by me to inherit the Tianji Record, but he was abandoned due to severe injuries, dying state, and incompatible fate. She saved him, and thus became entangled in this karma." Chen Ji's fingers holding the jade pendant trembled slightly. A father's debt should be repaid by the son—this is natural justice. Moreover... this was clearly a life-saving kindness!

A trace of emotion flickered in Ye Qing's eyes, but quickly returned to calm. She replaced her veil, her voice gaining a softer tone. "Since that's the case, from now on, you and I are allies. The Demonic Path Saint and the righteous path废物... rather interesting." Chen Ji tucked the jade pendant into his chest, raising his eyes to look at her. "Since we're allies, the Saint might as well speak frankly—what exactly is the Holy Sect scheming? And why has my sister... drawn their attention?" Ye Qing was silent for a moment, then waved her slender hand—a幽紫 glow condensing into a complex formation map in the air. "This is merely the tip of the iceberg of the Holy Sect's 'Heavenly Fate Key' plan. Your sister Chen Nian possesses a heavenly fate reversing aura by birth—she can interfere with the foresight of any prophetic divine ability." Chen Ji's pupils contracted violently. So that was it! Those blurred images of her appearing in the Tianji Record... "The Holy Sect wants to use her ability to open an ancient forbidden land." Ye Qing's voice abruptly grew heavy. "What is sealed there... is a fragment of the Heaven's Eye's soul."

Heaven's Eye! Chen Ji's heart was shaken to its core. That ultimate antagonist, that terrifying existence that had used generations of prophecy seers as chess pieces, had already set their pieces this far! "So you sought my cooperation..." he said deeply. "Not merely to repay a debt." Ye Qing admitted frankly. "The Heaven's Eye is awakening, the Holy Sect wants to open the forbidden grounds, the three major sects are at each other's throats—this chess game has reached its critical endgame. And the Tianji Record Fragment in your hands is the only eye that can see through the entire board." She took a pitch-black token from her sleeve and handed it to Chen Ji. "This is the Holy Sect Saint's token. With this token, you can pass freely within Holy Sect territory. More importantly... it can conceal the aura of the Tianji Record." Chen Ji took the token, which felt ice-cold and weighty. "What does this mean?" "The Heaven's Eye can sense the existence of the Tianji Record." Ye Qing's voice was low. "If it locks onto you, you won't survive seven hundred chapters. This token... is the last protective talisman I can give you."

choice.prompt: Ye Qing hands over the Holy Sect token—this is proof of her sincerity, but also a dangerous invitation. How should Chen Ji choose?

choices.text: Accept the token, form an alliance
choices.description: Chen Ji chooses to trust Ye Qing, officially forming a forbidden alliance between the Demonic Path Saint and the righteous path废物.
choices.visible_cost: Bearing the suspicion of colluding with the Demonic Path
choices.visible_reward: Obtaining the Holy Sect passage token, concealing heavenly secrets aura

dialogue.content: I've taken the token. However... between us, it's cooperation, not subordination.

choices.description: The Demonic Path token is too dangerous—Chen Ji doesn't want to leave evidence, choosing only a verbal agreement.
choices.visible_cost: Losing the chance to conceal his aura
choices.visible_reward: Maintaining a clean reputation, leaving no evidence

dialogue.content: The token is too conspicuous... As for our affairs, mutual understanding is enough.

text.content: Ye Qing watched Chen Ji pocket the token, a barely perceptible smile flickering in her eyes. "You're more decisive than I imagined." "Not decisive." Chen Ji tucked the token close to his body. "It's having no choice. Since I'm destined to die within seven hundred chapters, I might as well drag a few陪葬." Ye Qing laughed lightly. "Interesting. No wonder the Tianji Record chose you." She turned and walked to the window, moonlight elongating her graceful figure. "In three days, the Xuanwu Sect will hold a Dao Discussion Grand Ceremony. The outstanding young cultivators of all three major sects will attend... including Han Lie, who always targets you." Chen Ji's eyes flickered. "Does the Saint have any guidance?" "There will be unexpected events at that time." Ye Qing turned back, her gaze deep. "What the Tianji Record didn't tell you, I'll tell you now—there's an aura of the Heaven's Eye on Han Lie. He has already been chosen." The moment her words fell, the幽紫 barrier suddenly dissipated. Ye Qing's figure vanished like smoke and mist into the night, leaving only one sentence echoing in the air: "Three days later, see you at Xuanwu Sect. At that time... I still have a grand gift for you."

Chen Ji sat alone by the window, the Holy Sect token in his hand. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his Mental Sea, carrying rare solemnity. "She spoke true. The aura on Han Lie... is exactly the same as what I sensed in the ancient ruins." "The Heaven's Eye has already positioned itself on Han Lie?" Chen Ji murmured to himself. "Not only that." Mo Xiansheng's voice grew heavier. "I just sensed that your sister's aura... is in the direction of Xuanwu Sect. She's still alive!" Chen Ji rose abruptly, his eyes blazing. Chen Nian... wait for me! He tucked the token into his chest, his gaze sweeping across the vast night outside the window. The death sentence of seven hundred chapters, the Heaven's Eye's scheme, the Demonic Path Saint's alliance, his sister's life-and-death mystery... this chess game is getting more interesting by the moment. A cold smile curved at his lips—that smile was icy and sharp. Since all of you want to treat me as a chess piece—let's see who is the true执棋者!

Night wind brushed past, making the candle by Chen Ji's side flicker unstably. Just then, the Holy Sect token in his bosom suddenly grew warm. Chen Ji's brow furrowed; he took out the token—on its surface, a line of幽紫 small characters appeared: "Be careful of Ling Yuan. He knows who you met tonight." Chen Ji's pupils contracted violently. Ling Yuan... that old sect master who superficially sheltered him but harbored hidden malice! He actually had a way to monitor him? Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his Mental Sea, carrying a hint of solemnity: "That girl Ye Qing... gave you an early warning. It seems her cooperation is absolutely sincere." Chen Ji was silent for a moment, then tucked the token into the most hidden part of his bosom. Ling Yuan... this debt, I'll remember. When I have the spare capacity, I'll definitely teach you what it means to扮猪吃虎. Outside the window, the east had begun to glow with dawn. A new day is about to begin.
